title.pt: Os raios seguem o verão, de 2017 a 2023
title.es: Los rayos siguen al verano, de 2017 a 2023

source: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, "Lightning Events Detected from the International Space Station (ISS) 2017-2023" (SVS 5011), flat map version. https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5011/

extraction.note: Frames: every 40th frame of NASA's flat-map MP4 (frames 460 to 5920, between the fade-in and the fade-out), scaled to 960x480. Each NASA frame shows the lightning events of a 10-day roving window as yellow dots. Value: the share of each hemisphere band's pixels drawn in that yellow (red > 120 and red minus blue > 70), from 67.5 degrees to the equator. It measures how much of the map is covered by lightning dots; it is NOT a count of flashes. ASSUMPTION ABOUT TIME: this version of the video prints no date. NASA states the data runs from March 2017 to July 2023. We measured that the video does not advance at a constant rate, so we do not give dates. We only give the YEAR, inferred from the data itself: lightning swings north then south once a year, the video shows seven northern peaks (2017 to 2023), and we start each new year in the middle of the stretch where the south leads. A label can be wrong by a few months around each new year.

meaning.en: Lightning north of the equator: higher, louder tone = more of the map covered by lightning
meaning.pt: Raios ao norte do equador: tom mais agudo e mais forte = mais área do mapa coberta por raios
meaning.es: Rayos al norte del ecuador: tono más agudo y más fuerte = más área del mapa cubierta por rayos

meaning.en: Lightning south of the equator: louder, brighter wind = more of the map covered by lightning
meaning.pt: Raios ao sul do equador: vento mais forte e mais brilhante = mais área do mapa coberta por raios
meaning.es: Rayos al sur del ecuador: viento más fuerte y más brillante = más área del mapa cubierta por rayos

intro.en: Lightning seen from the International Space Station, from 2017 to 2023, a visualization by NASA. The tone is lightning north of the equator. The wind is lightning south of it. A strong tick marks each new year. The video shows no dates, so the years are our estimate from the seasons. Listen to the lightning follow the summer across the equator.
intro.pt: Raios vistos da Estação Espacial Internacional, de 2017 a 2023, uma visualização da NASA. O tom são os raios ao norte do equador. O vento são os raios ao sul. Um tique forte marca cada ano novo. O vídeo não mostra datas, então os anos são nossa estimativa pelas estações. Ouça os raios seguirem o verão de um lado ao outro do equador.
intro.es: Rayos vistos desde la Estación Espacial Internacional, de 2017 a 2023, una visualización de la NASA. El tono son los rayos al norte del ecuador. El viento son los rayos al sur. Un tic fuerte marca cada año nuevo. El video no muestra fechas, así que los años son nuestra estimación por las estaciones. Escucha los rayos seguir al verano de un lado al otro del ecuador.
